MI Assistant

Ask in plain language — the assistant works out the intent, asks back when unsure, and every answer is computed deterministically in your browser from the filtered data. Nothing leaves this page.

Governed scope: questions are read in plain language and answered from the approved set of analyses (performance, movements and drivers, breakdowns, costs, ECL, targets, comparisons) — anything outside it is asked back, never guessed.
